blocks.text: EXT. SESHACHALAM FOREST — DAWN
Mist rolls between ancient sandalwood trees. The forest is alive — birds, insects, rustling. Camera drifts through the canopy.

Pushpa Raj ki location batao. Nahi toh gaon mein ek bhi aadmi nahi bachega.

VILLAGER
Saab, Pushpa anna gaon mein nahi hai. Jangal mein gaye.
EXT. TEMPLE ENTRANCE — DUSK
Oil lamps flicker at the ancient temple entrance. Srivalli stands at the threshold, wind catching her dupatta.
SRIVALLI
(turning, seeing someone approach)
Pushpa... nuvvu tirigochav.
PUSHPA
Nenu entha dooram vellina, nee daggiriki vasthanu Srivalli.

blocks.text: EXT. GOVERNMENT BUILDING — DAWN
A massive government building against the dawn sky. Flags flutter. Security guards patrol. A convoy of white Ambassador cars pulls up.
RAM NANDAN

System ni change cheyyalanukuntunna. Lopalunchi.

ELECTION OFFICER
Results announce chestunnam. Silence maintain cheyandi.

(under his breath)
Ee result tho era maaripothundi.
INT. STATE LEGISLATIVE ASSEMBLY — DAY
The assembly is in uproar. MLAs shout across the aisle. Ram Nandan stands at the podium, unflinching. CM Boora Narsaiah watches from the treasury bench, seething.
RAM NANDAN
Ee assembly lo nijam cheppina vaadiki chair ledu. Kaani nenu naa duty vadlanu.
CM BOORA NARSAIAH
(standing, furious)
Nuvvu IAS officer vi. Nee panilo nuvvu undu. Rajakeeyam naaku vaddu.

blocks.text: EXT. ANCESTRAL PALACE — GATE — NIGHT
A towering Gothic palace looms against a stormy sky. Iron gates creak open on their own. Lightning illuminates gargoyle rain spouts and crumbling balustrades.
RAJA
(nervously looking up at the palace)
Property papers sign cheyyadaaniki vacchanu. Oka raatri stay cheste chaalu annaru. Easy ga...
Thunder BOOMS. Raja flinches. He squares his shoulders and walks through the gate.
INT. ANCESTRAL PALACE — PORTRAIT HALL — NIGHT
A long hall lined with oil portraits of ancestors. Moonlight streams through tall windows. Raja walks slowly, eyeing the portraits. In one ornate mirror, a figure materializes behind him.
THE GHOST
(appearing in the mirror, amused)
Naa palace ki welcome, raja gaaru. Ikkada oka raatri ante... naa conditions ki agree avvaali.
RAJA
Meeru... meeru nijam ga... bhootham aa?
INT. ANCESTRAL PALACE — GRAND BALLROOM — NIGHT
A vast ballroom in pristine vintage condition — as if frozen in time. Crystal chandeliers blaze. Period-costumed dancers fill the floor. Raja stands at the entrance, stunned.
THE GHOST
Dance cheyyandi raja gaaru. Ee palace lo celebrate cheyyani raatri undadu.
CUT TO:

blocks.text: EXT. SESHACHALAM FOREST CHECKPOST - DAWN
Pushpa's convoy of milk tankers rolls through a forest checkpost with red sandalwood hidden under false floors.
PUSHPA RAJ
Count the tankers again. You will still miss the one that matters.
INT. PUSHPA'S HOUSE - NIGHT
Srivalli asks Pushpa for one photograph with the Chief Minister, and he decides it is a matter of honour.
PUSHPA RAJ
You asked for a photo. I will bring you the man who signs them.
INT. SYNDICATE GODOWN - DAY
Pushpa renegotiates the syndicate's cut and names a new price per tonne in front of every partner.
PUSHPA RAJ
The forest sets the price now. I only announce it.
EXT. GANGAMMA JATHARA GROUNDS - NIGHT
Pushpa leads the Jathara procession in full ritual costume before a fight erupts around the chariot.
PUSHPA RAJ
Tonight the goddess walks. Clear the road.
INT. SP OFFICE - DAY
Shekhawat maps the smuggling routes on a wall and swears to break the syndicate from the inside.
SP BHANWAR SINGH SHEKHAWAT
Every road he owns starts at a checkpost I control.
EXT. CHENNAI PORT CONTAINER YARD - NIGHT
A consignment bound for Japan is switched between containers minutes before the customs raid.
PUSHPA RAJ
Wrong container, right time. Open it and see.
EXT. FOREST RIVER CROSSING - DAY
Logs are floated across the river while Shekhawat's men close in from both banks.
PUSHPA RAJ
The river does not check permits.
INT. WEDDING HALL - NIGHT
A family wedding turns into a standoff when Pushpa walks in uninvited and takes the front row.
PUSHPA RAJ
I was not invited. I came anyway. That is the difference between us.

blocks.text: EXT. KASI WASTELAND - DAY
Bhairava chases a bounty across the dry riverbed in Bujji while raiders close in.
BHAIRAVA
One more bounty and I buy my way into the Complex.
INT. COMPLEX LABORATORY - NIGHT
Sumathi discovers the truth about Project K and slips out of the lab during a shift change.
SUMATHI
They count us every hour. Tonight they will count one less.
EXT. SHAMBHALA GATES - DUSK
The rebels bring Sumathi through the hidden gates as the refuge prepares for a siege.
SUMATHI
The tree has waited six thousand years. It can wait one more night.
INT. ASHWATTHAMA'S CAVE TEMPLE - NIGHT
Ashwatthama senses the child and rises after centuries of penance.
ASHWATTHAMA
I failed once to protect the unborn. Not again.
EXT. SHAMBHALA BATTLEFIELD - DAY
Bhairava and Ashwatthama collide in the sand arena while Complex raiders breach the wall.
BHAIRAVA
You fight like someone who has forgotten who he was.

blocks.text: EXT. RED SEA COAST - NIGHT
Devara's men board a cargo ship from small boats and unload crates before the coast guard light sweeps past.
DEVARA
The sea gives to those who are not afraid of it.
EXT. FISHING VILLAGE SHORE - DAY
Devara tells the four villages that the smuggling ends tonight and breaks his own weapon in the sand.
DEVARA
From today the sea is only for fishing.
INT. BHAIRA'S HOUSE - NIGHT
Bhaira gathers the other clans and plans to remove Devara during the weapon festival.
BHAIRA
A man who scares the sea must be made to fear the land.
EXT. CLIFF TEMPLE - DAWN
Thangam watches Vara fumble through the ritual and wonders if he is his father's son.
DEVARA
Everyone tells stories about Devara. Tell me one about you.

blocks.text: EXT. DISTRICT COLLECTORATE - DAY
Ram Nandan takes charge as Collector and suspends three officers before he reaches his chair.
RAM NANDAN IAS
File by file, we start today.
INT. ASSEMBLY HALL - NIGHT
Minister Satyamoorthy moves a late-night motion to transfer Ram Nandan as the opposition walks out.
MINISTER M. K. SATYAMOORTHY
An officer serves five years here. I have served this state for thirty.
EXT. STADIUM ELECTION RALLY - DUSK
Ram Nandan lands by helicopter and announces the election code in front of a hostile rally.
RAM NANDAN IAS
The code applies to everyone on this stage. Including me.
INT. COUNTING CENTRE - NIGHT
Deepika finds the missing ballot register while Satyamoorthy's men cut the power.
RAM NANDAN IAS
They switched off the lights. They forgot the registers are written by hand.

blocks.text: EXT. SASSOON DOCK - NIGHT
OG steps off a trawler after ten years and the dock workers stop mid-shift to watch him walk.
OG
Ten years is a long time. Not long enough for them to forget.
INT. IRANI CAFE - DAY
Vimala asks OG to leave the city before Omi learns he is back.
OG
I came back for a promise. Not for the city.
INT. OMI BHAU'S BAR - NIGHT
Omi Bhau celebrates taking the port, until a single glass arrives at his table with OG's name.
OMI BHAU
Send it back. Tell him I do not drink with ghosts.
EXT. GHAT ROAD - DAWN
OG's vintage Dodge is boxed in by three jeeps on the ghat and he turns the car around.
OG
They brought three cars. They should have counted again.

blocks.text: EXT. DAL LAKE HOUSEBOAT - DAWN
Arjun Sarkaar is rowed to a houseboat where the third victim has been found in the same pattern.
ARJUN SARKAAR
Same knot. Same hour. He wants us to keep count.
INT. HIT INTERROGATION ROOM - NIGHT
Arjun breaks protocol in the interrogation room while the DGP watches through the glass.
ARJUN SARKAAR
I am not here for your confession. I am here for the next name.
INT. FORENSIC LAB - DAY
Mrudula matches the fibre to a plantation and Arjun realises the cases are connected across states.
ARJUN SARKAAR
Three states, one fibre. That is not a coincidence, that is a route.
EXT. PLANTATION HIDEOUT - NIGHT
The HIT team surrounds the hideout and Arjun goes in alone before backup arrives.
ARJUN SARKAAR
Hold the perimeter. If I am not out in five minutes, burn it down.

blocks.text: EXT. RAJA SAAB PALACE GATES - DUSK
Raja arrives to claim the palace he has inherited and the gates open before he touches them.
RAJA SAAB
A palace this size and nobody wants it? Wonderful. I will take it.
INT. DURBAR HALL - NIGHT
At dinner the chandelier lights itself and the portrait of the old Thakur is found facing the wall.
RAJA SAAB
Either the electrician is very good, or someone here does not like guests.
INT. LOCKED EAST WING - NIGHT
Maya opens the east wing and finds the room where the ancestor still holds court.
ANCESTRAL THAKUR
He is not haunting the palace. He never left it.
EXT. FERNHILL ESTATE LAWN - DAY
A flashback shows the young Thakur losing the estate in a card game and swearing never to leave.
ANCESTRAL THAKUR
Take the land. The house keeps me.

blocks.text: EXT. CHARMINAR LANE — NIGHT
Sodium lamps buzz over the shuttered lane. A lone yellow-plate cab idles at the corner, wipers ticking against a light drizzle.
SURI
(wiping the windshield, half to himself)
This city sleeps for nobody. It only changes shifts.
Suri checks the meter, then the rear-view mirror. A man in a white shirt is running towards the cab.
EXT. DEMOLITION SITE — NIGHT
Floodlights snap on as three police jeeps pull up beside the half-broken basti wall. Residents gather behind the rubble.
ACP RUDRA PRAKASH
Find me the cab that left this lane at two. The driver saw everything.
ACP Rudra Prakash steps out in full uniform. His men fan out. The residents fall silent.
RESIDENT
Sir, that cab is Suri's. He has not come home tonight.
EXT. MUSI BRIDGE — DAWN
First light over the river. Meera waits by the railing with a steel tiffin box, watching every cab that crosses.
MEERA
(turning, seeing the cab pull over)
Suri... where were you all night?
SURI
I picked up one passenger, Meera. Now the whole city is looking for me.
CUT TO:

projects.title: Mahanagaram
projects.logline: Mahanagaram follows Suri, a night-shift cab driver in Hyderabad, who witnesses a murder that ties a powerful constructio...
projects.description: Mahanagaram follows Suri, a night-shift cab driver in Hyderabad, who witnesses a murder that ties a powerful construction empire to a land scam displacing an old basti. Hunted by both the police and the builder’s men, he must decide whether to disappear or testify. Shot across Hyderabad, Warangal and Chennai over 120 days with extensive night exteriors, two song montages and a 12-minute single-take chase through the old city.

projects.title: Pushpa 2: The Rule
projects.logline: Pushpa Raj faces a fierce war with SP Bhanwar Singh Shekhawat and syndicate bosses as his red-sandalwood empire expands.
projects.description: Pushpa Raj consolidates his syndicate empire across the Seshachalam forests into international waters, colliding with SP Bhanwar Singh Shekhawat in an explosive showdown of ego, survival, and absolute dominance.

projects.title: Kalki 2898 AD
projects.logline: In the dystopian city of Kasi 2898 AD, bounty hunter Bhairava and the immortal Ashwatthama clash over pregnant refugee Sumathi carrying the savior of mankind.
projects.producer: C. Aswani Dutt, Swapna Dutt, Priyanka Dutt
projects.description: Set in a post-apocalyptic future where the Complex controls all resources, Kalki 2898 AD follows Bhairava, the immortal warrior Ashwatthama, and Supreme Yaskin in an epic technological-mythological clash for the unborn avatar.

projects.title: Devara: Part 1
projects.logline: A fearless coastal chieftain Devara fights to stop his clan's smuggling empire, leaving his fearful son Varadha to protect his legacy from ruthless rivals.
projects.description: Spanning the treacherous coastal tides of the Red Sea clan, Devara: Part 1 chronicles the fierce confrontation between Devara and Bhaira over arms smuggling, family vengeance, and enduring bloodlines.

projects.title: Game Changer
projects.logline: An unyielding IAS officer wages war against corrupt political kingpins to revolutionize state electoral democracy.
projects.description: Ram Nandan IAS spearheads a fierce battle against deeply entrenched political corruption, deploying radical constitutional mechanisms and voter awareness to defeat an oligarchic syndicate.

projects.title: They Call Him OG
projects.logline: Ojas Gambheera, a feared underworld boss who vanished a decade ago, resurfaces in Mumbai to settle unfinished blood debts.
projects.description: Ten years after vanishing into exile, gangster Ojas Gambheera (OG) returns to the Mumbai underworld to dismantle criminal baron Omi Bhau's syndicate in a stylish neo-noir bloodbath.

projects.title: HIT: The Third Case
projects.logline: Fierce cop Arjun Sarkaar is drafted into the Homicide Intervention Team's darkest cross-border serial murder investigation.
projects.description: SP Arjun Sarkaar takes charge of the HIT franchise's most brutal interstate manhunt, tracking an elusive predator whose cryptic psychological patterns push Sarkaar to the very edge of sanity.

projects.title: The Raja Saab
projects.logline: A young romantic discovers his royal ancestral estate is guarded by an eccentric ghost with a bizarre claim to his bloodline.
projects.description: Blending lavish vintage horror aesthetics with slapstick romance, The Raja Saab follows an easygoing heir navigating an eccentric royal spirit within a labyrinthine haunted palace.
